# Support

Looking for help with Innovator? Here's how to get support.

## 📖 Documentation

Visit the [Innovator documentation site](https://josedab.github.io/innovator/) for comprehensive guides, API reference, and tutorials:

- [Getting Started](https://josedab.github.io/innovator/docs/getting-started)
- [Configuration](https://josedab.github.io/innovator/docs/configuration)
- [Troubleshooting](https://josedab.github.io/innovator/docs/troubleshooting)

## 💬 GitHub Discussions

For questions, ideas, and community conversations, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/josedab/innovator/discussions):

- **[Q&A](https://github.com/josedab/innovator/discussions/categories/q-a)** — Ask questions about setup, usage, or troubleshooting
- **[Ideas](https://github.com/josedab/innovator/discussions/categories/ideas)** — Propose new features, angles, or improvements

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Feature Requests

If you've found a bug or have a concrete feature request, please open an issue using the appropriate template:

- [Bug Report](https://github.com/josedab/innovator/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
- [Feature Request](https://github.com/josedab/innovator/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)

Before opening an issue, please search [existing issues](https://github.com/josedab/innovator/issues) to avoid duplicates.

## 🔒 Security Vulnerabilities

To report a security vulnerability, please follow the instructions in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). **Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**
